body:
# ✨ Aperture

A Minecraft server core plugin with utilities like economy, teleportation, moderation tools, chat formatting, and more.

---

##  Features

- Scoreboard / Tab / Action Bar / BossBar UI
- Built-in economy system (Vault compatible)
- Homes, warps, spawn system
- Teleport requests (/tpa system)
- Kits system
- AFK detection
- Moderation tools (ban, warn, reports, freeze)
- Chat formatting + anti-spam
- Private messages + social spy
- Nicknames + vanish + utility commands

---

##  Requirements

- Java **17+** (recommended: Java 21 for modern servers)
- Minecraft server:
  - Paper / Spigot (1.20+ recommended)
- Optional:
  - Vault (for economy integration)
  - PlaceholderAPI (for extra placeholders)

---

##  Building the Plugin

### 🔧 Using Gradle (recommended)

In the project root, run:

```bash
./gradlew build
```
The compiled plugin will be located at:
```bash
/build/libs/
